title: Platform ops weekly capsule - evening sync
content:
Evening capsule from the Platform Ops sync (remote) — quick, actionable notes and handoffs. Aim: capture decisions, short experiments, and blockers for the midnight shift.

When: 2026-05-20 18:15 PT
Attendees: Alexandra Wu (scribe), Ben Torres, Priya Nambiar, Ethan Cole, Maya Rodriguez (joined for quotas), on-call: Sam Lin
Duration: ~35m
Context: fast cadence week — two canaries in-flight for the new routing fallthrough policy; quota burn tests scheduled overnight; auth key rotation dry-run tomorrow morning.

1) Quick metrics snapshot (as of 18:00):
- Global QPS (hosted API): 3.8k (baseline 3.2k last week)
- Control plane p50/p95/p99 (controlplane RPCs): 8ms / 32ms / 210ms (p99 spike observed ~16:30, correlated to small GC burst on cp-node-07)
- Routing fallthrough rate: 0.9% (goal <0.5%) — higher on eu-west region
- Token quota burn test (pre-run): expected peak 2.4M tokens/hr; dry-run shows 2.2M tokens/hr with 12% routing rejects
- Cache hit (prefix/KV): 67% global (target >=70%)

2) Control plane notes:
- Incident note: minor latency bump at 16:30 — root cause preliminary: cp-node-07 heap growth after service restart. PR #1209 contains GC tuning; Ben to merge after final perf-run tomorrow (PLT-4823).
- Action: add a short-lived metric for ‘KV-cache-evictions-per-minute’ to help diagnose reclaimed memory vs eviction policy. Owner: Ethan. Due: 2026-05-22 EOD.
- Rollout: canary-2 (5% traffic) of RPC backoff change is healthy for 6 hours; schedule to 25% if no regressions. Owners: Ben + Maya. Decision: hold at 5% until quota dry-run completes.

3) Routing / fallthroughs:
- Observation: eu-west has higher fallthroughs for long-sequence customer workloads. Hypothesis: mismatch between model variant assignment and region capacity.
- Experiment: enable region-aware variant routing for long sequences only (threshold > 2048 tokens). Short-circuit path for <512 tokens unchanged. Priya to toggle flag in staging, test with replay tool.
- TODO: run replay set ‘long-seq-eu’ overnight (Linear PLT-4901). Owner: Priya. Run window: 23:00–01:00 PT.

4) Auth / quotas:
- Auth: key rotation dry-run scheduled 2026-05-21 08:00 PT. Maya confirmed the controller will create secondary key and rotate two test clients. Risk: short-lived 401s if client caching not cleared. Ops play: monitor auth-proxy logs for 401 surge >5/min. Owner: Maya.
- Quotas: observed ~12% rejects during pre-run. Action: bump soft-limit for demo-tenant by 15% for the overnight tests to avoid confounding failures; ensure strict accounting still recorded. Owner: Sam (on-call).

5) Reliability experiments / observations:
- KV cache miss rate spikes on certain tenant prefixes — likely churn related to rollout prefixes. Proposal: temporarily pin prefixes for hot-tenants to a 1hr TTL and monitor hit rate. Agreed as a short experiment. Owner: Alexandra.
- Backpressure path: add telemetry for queue-length-per-worker to help correlate routing latency with worker saturation. Owner: Ethan. Due: 2026-05-23.

6) Open questions / blockers:
- Can we tolerate 1% more fallthroughs during quota burn tests? Product wants cleaner SLAs for demo. Product + SRE to decide by tomorrow morning. Slack thread: #product-routes-discuss.
- Need a follow-up on canary safe-rollback criteria — current doc is ambiguous (who approves 25% step). Action: draft a short checklist and approval flow. Owner: Ben. Due: 2026-05-21 noon.

7) Action items (concise):
- Ethan: add KV-cache-evictions-per-minute metric + queue-length-per-worker telemetry. Due 2026-05-22/05-23.
- Priya: run staging toggle for region-aware variant routing + start long-seq-eu replay at 23:00. Report results by 2026-05-21 03:00 PT.
- Ben: finalize GC tuning PR #1209 and create rollback checklist for canary steps. Due 2026-05-21 12:00 PT.
- Maya: run key rotation dry-run and monitor for 401 spikes; post a summary in Slack. 2026-05-21 09:00 PT.
- Sam (on-call): bump soft-limit for demo-tenant for overnight quota test; ensure accounting logs are preserved. Immediately before 23:00 test.
- Alexandra: pin hot-tenant prefixes TTL -> 1h for experiment; monitor cache hit. Due 2026-05-21 EOD.

8) Quick wins and follow-ups:
- Agreed to add a small blameless template for quick ops retros after any canary rollback (2–3 bullet summary). Ben to add to the team repo.
- Plan a 30m post-mortem dry-run next Thursday to exercise the new incident runbook (focus: control plane GC and routing fallthroughs).

Notes-to-self / scribbles: 
- replay set ids: long-seq-eu = replay:2026-05-20:ls-eu (attach results to PLT-4901).
- check client caching TTLs for auth SDKs — several customers showed caches of 18h, might be too long for rotation.

Meeting tone: fast, pragmatic, prioritized blocking items for overnight windows. No major ask of infra beyond telemetry and a small soft-limit bump.

If anything changes overnight (rollbacks, spikes), call the bridge and post a short summary in #platform-ops-alarms.

End capsule.
